name: 33032 · Homestead, FL
findings: ZIP 33032 (Homestead) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33032 (Homestead) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33032 (Homestead) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
